name: Parker Plastics Inc
old_description: Parker Plastics – delivering customer driven packaging solutions since 1989
about:
Parker Plastics Inc, headquartered in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin, was founded in 1989. The company operates four manufacturing facilities in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin; Sand Springs, Oklahoma; Hagerstown, Maryland; and North Las Vegas, Nevada.

Parker Plastics specializes in custom blow molding, offering PET and extrusion manufacturing across 47 production lines. Its equipment includes 27 two-stage reheat blow molding machines, three single-stage machines, and seven shuttle machines, collectively producing over 1.7 million bottles per day in sizes from 2 ounces to 5 gallons. The company also provides co-extrusion for multi-layer HDPE containers, hot-fill capabilities up to 200°F, HPP and aseptic-compatible bottles, in-house decoration (pressure-sensitive, sleeve labeling, heat transfer), and warehousing at each facility. All resins are FDA-compliant and BPA-free.

The company serves food and beverage markets including honey and agave, dressings and sauces, mustard and condiments, specialty beverages, edible oils, liquor and mixer bottles, as well as household chemicals, agricultural chemicals, food service, pharmaceutical and medical, and home and office water.

Parker Plastics emphasizes a customer-driven model built on flexibility and responsiveness, offering custom container programs, just-in-time delivery, and stocking programs. Its quality system is SQF-certified at all four plants and tailored to client specifications, supported by an ERP system for custom labeling and tracking.
